# OECD series: oecd-series (OECDS)

One OECD measure of one member by period: the history, the latest value and the change. One row per oecd series, keyed by SERIES_ID. Read by the **oecd** pack's connector `oecd-store` (table `<root>/oecd/oecd-series/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/oecd/samples/oecd-series.jsonl`, 10 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/oecd/samples/oecd-series.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `SERIES_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 10 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "CHANGE": 0.0529,
  "COUNTRY_NAME": "United States",
  "DATAFLOW": "OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_CLI,",
  "FREQUENCY": "monthly",
  "HISTORY": [
    {
      "PERIOD": "2024-01",
      "VALUE": 99.09195
    },
    {
      "PERIOD": "2024-02",
      "VALUE": 99.19873
    },
    "… 31 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "ISO3": "USA",
  "LATEST": 100.9993,
  "LATEST_PERIOD": "2026-09",
  "MEASURE": "CLI",
  "NAME": "United States · Composite leading indicator",
  "OECD_COUNTRY": "OECD-USA",
  "PREVIOUS": 100.9464,
  "PREVIOUS_PERIOD": "2026-08",
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "ATTRIBUTION": "Source: OECD Data Explorer (CC BY 4.0).",
    "DATASET": "OECD DSD_STES@DF_CLI",
    "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,
    "LICENCE": "OECD terms and conditions: data may be extracted, copied and redistributed, also commercially, with the source acknowledged (CC BY 4.0 for OECD data since July 2024)",
    "RETRIEVED_AT": "2026-11-06",
    "SOURCE": "OECD",
    "URL": "https://data-explorer.oecd.org/?lc=en&df[ds]=dsDisseminateFinalDMZ&df[id]=DSD_STES%40DF_CLI"
  },
  "SERIES_ID": "OECDS-USA-CLI",
  "TITLE": "Composite leading indicator",
  "UNIT": "index, long-term average = 100"
}
```

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CHANGE` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The latest value less the previous one. | unit: the record's UNIT | `0.0529` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The member's name as the OECD writes it. | seen: `Canada`, `United States`, `Australia` | `"United States"` |
| `DATAFLOW` | string | required | The OECD dataflow (agency, id, version) the series is read from. | seen: `OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAMAIN1@DF_QNA_EXPENDITURE_GROWTH_OECD,1.1`, `OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_CLI,`, `OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_LFS@DF_IALFS_UNE_M,1.0`, `OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_PRICES@DF_PRICES_ALL,1.0` | `"OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_CLI,"` |
| `FREQUENCY` | string | optional (filled in every row) | Monthly or quarterly, from the feed's YAML. | seen: `monthly`, `quarterly` | `"monthly"` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The value by period, oldest first, over the feed's history-periods (PERIOD, VALUE). | — | [33 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].PERIOD` | string | required | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | — | `"2024-01"` |
| `HISTORY[].VALUE` | number | required | The value for that period, in the unit shown. | unit: the record's UNIT | `99.09195` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. | seen: `CAN`, `USA`, `AUS` | `"USA"` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The latest value, in the unit shown. | unit: the record's UNIT | `100.9993` |
| `LATEST_PERIOD` | string | required | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | seen: `2026-09`, `2026-Q3`, `2026-Q2` | `"2026-09"` |
| `MEASURE` | string | required | The measure's id in the feed's YAML. | seen: `CLI`, `GDP_GROWTH`, `INFLATION`, `UNEMPLOYMENT` | `"CLI"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The member and the measure, as one name. | — | `"United States · Composite leading indicator"` |
| `OECD_COUNTRY` | string | required | The member's oecd-country page (OECD-<ISO3>). | pattern `^OECD-`; links to `oecd-country` | `"OECD-USA"` |
| `PREVIOUS` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The previous period's value. | unit: the record's UNIT | `100.9464` |
| `PREVIOUS_PERIOD` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | seen: `2026-08`, `2026-Q2`, `2026-Q1` | `"2026-08"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: OECD Data Explorer (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The OECD dataflow the record was built from. | seen: `OECD DSD_NAMAIN1@DF_QNA_EXPENDITURE_GROWTH_OECD`, `OECD DSD_STES@DF_CLI`, `OECD DSD_LFS@DF_IALFS_UNE_M`, `OECD DSD_PRICES@DF_PRICES_ALL` | `"OECD DSD_STES@DF_CLI"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"OECD terms and conditions: data may be extracted, copied a…` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | — | `"OECD"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The OECD Data Explorer's page for the dataflow. | seen: `https://data-explorer.oecd.org/?lc=en&df[ds]=dsDisseminateFinalDMZ&df[id]=DSD_NAMAIN1%40DF_QNA_EXPENDITURE_GROWTH_OECD`, `https://data-explorer.oecd.org/?lc=en&df[ds]=dsDisseminateFinalDMZ&df[id]=DSD_STES%40DF_CLI`, `https://data-explorer.oecd.org/?lc=en&df[ds]=dsDisseminateFinalDMZ&df[id]=DSD_LFS%40DF_IALFS_UNE_M`, `https://data-explorer.oecd.org/?lc=en&df[ds]=dsDisseminateFinalDMZ&df[id]=DSD_PRICES%40DF_PRICES_ALL` | `"https://data-explorer.oecd.org/?lc=en&df[ds]=dsDisseminate…` |
| `SERIES_ID` | string | required | OECDS-, the member's ISO alpha-3 code and the measure's id. | pattern `^OECDS-` | `"OECDS-USA-CLI"` |
| `TITLE` | string | required | The measure's title in the feed's YAML. | seen: `Composite leading indicator`, `Real GDP growth, quarter on quarter`, `Consumer price inflation, year on year`, `Unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted` | `"Composite leading indicator"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | What the measure is in. | seen: `%`, `index, long-term average = 100`, `% a year`, `% of labour force` | `"index, long-term average = 100"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 10 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SERIES_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SERIES_ID`, `NAME`, `OECD_COUNTRY`, `ISO3`, `MEASURE`, `TITLE`, `UNIT`, `DATAFLOW`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_PERIOD`, `HISTORY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `CHANGE`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `FREQUENCY`, `PREVIOUS`, `PREVIOUS_PERIOD`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `SERIES_ID` per snapshot.
- `SERIES_ID` matches `^OECDS-`.
